geocoding_review_notes: Globe search found several road segments and a park, not an unambiguous damaged bridge: unlocated.
Gumba search found a Bridge International Academy school and toilets, not a verified bridge: unlocated.
Mathare school search first result is drinking water: rejected; selected the school amenity node.
inventory_limitations: The v0.2 attachment supplies 28 place/landmark coordinates and 12 unresolved records; none are incident-specific field-verified flood points.

Two reviewed OSM references are retained, including one unresolved in the attachment. T-Mall, Uhuru Highway and seven previously unresolved records use separately recorded user-supplied points; four records the user could not locate were removed. Total: 36 mapped area records and no unresolved records.
Neighbourhood, school and reservoir references identify the displayed feature. They do not precisely locate the associated riverbank, households or substation.
Mapped records are assigned by reference-point containment in existing administrative polygons. Unlocated records retain explicitly tentative inventory groups.
Coincident source coordinates remain shared; no jitter or invented additional locations is applied.
Parent monitoring zones classify geography only. The frozen model zones, contracts and saved predictions are unchanged.

receipt.meaning: Local import time is not satellite acquisition, source publication or original network receipt.

nearby_water_source.reference_scope: Recomputed from authentic native shapes at current map coordinates; supplied lookup statistics were not copied across moved pins.

source_provenance.generalized_county_aoi_description: OSM-derived generalized outline; not official legal county boundary
limitations: Original reference coordinates are NOT flood incident locations.
500 m is a research radius, NOT a site boundary.
Satellite water is an observation of 2024-05-01, not a current flood.
Absence of mapped water is not proof of no flooding, especially outside analysis or in clouds.
UNOSAT preliminary mapping was not field validated.
Multiple clipped patches can overlap and must not be summed as independent flood areas.
No NDVI, imperviousness, high-resolution terrain, drainage or flood depth measurements were fabricated.
